name: Tobias Jedidiah Hess
source:
TJ Hess is one of the main characters of "Echo". He was born in Wasatchua, a small town in Canada. He moved to Echo when he was six years old, after his father got a job surveying the land and wildlife in the area.

He is prone to fear and crying while under moderate amounts of stress. As a child, he had anxiety disorders for which he took medication. His normal demeanor, however, is happy, optimistic, and charitable. This sometime leads to the lynx's kindness being taken advantage of.
